project_title: BuildSpec AI - Construction Blueprint & Spatial Dimension Intelligence
instructions_to_main_agent: Build a high-precision, technical construction blueprint scanner & spatial dimension AI SaaS dashboard.

Implement the layout with a collapsible Project History Sidebar (left), a central Interactive Blueprint Canvas Viewer with zoom/pan/bounding box overlays (center-top), a Structured Dimension Table with tabs for Rooms, Walls, Openings & CSV Export (center-bottom), and an AI Spatial Analysis Chat Q&A panel (right).
Use JavaScript (.js/.jsx) files (NOT TypeScript .tsx). Import Lucide React icons for UI controls.
Add explicit data-testid attributes to ALL interactive controls, buttons, tables, file dropzones, and input fields following kebab-case convention (e.g., data-testid='upload-blueprint-button').
Ensure contrast compliance with APCA/WCAG standards: dark obsidian slate `#0B0F17` background with warm amber `#F59E0B` and architectural cyan `#06B6D4` accents.
Do NOT use pure #000000 or default bright blue gradients. Use matte dark graphite `#111827` and slate `#1E293B` containers with 1px border strokes `#334155`.
Provide preset sample blueprints (e.g. Modern Villa Floorplan, Commercial Office Suite, Residential 2-Story) so the user can test instant analysis without uploading files.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never center-align the main App container text. Maintain structured left-aligned technical readability.
Use generous padding (p-6, p-8) inside card containers with explicit borders to avoid text truncation.
Do not apply global transition: all. Use targeted transitions on opacity, background-color, and border-color.
Do NOT use generic AI emojis (🤖, 🧠, 💡) for icons. Use clean Lucide icons (e.g., Ruler, Layers, Scale, FileSpreadsheet, Bot, Send, Eye, ZoomIn, Download).
All toasts must use the Sonner library (toast.success, toast.error, toast.info) with explicit dark custom styling.
Ensure every grid element is a direct child of the grid container or uses subgrid styling.

components_and_features.description: Lists saved blueprint projects with scale info, date, and status badges. Allows switching active blueprints and creating new project sessions.

Drag & drop upload zone supporting Blueprint Images (PNG/JPG) and PDFs with AI vision model selection (Gemini 3.1 Pro vs Gemini 2.5 Flash), scale setting (e.g. 1/4" = 1'0"), and sample blueprints loader.
Interactive Canvas container with Zoom (In/Out/Reset), Pan controls, Calibrate Scale tool, Layer Toggle (Rooms, Walls, Windows/Doors Bounding Boxes, Annotations), and full-screen expansion.

Tabs for Rooms (Name, Dimensions, Area sq ft/m², Height), Walls (Type, Length, Thickness, Material), and Openings (Doors/Windows, Width, Height, Header). Includes CSV export button and search/filter bar.

Spatial AI Q&A assistant for asking natural language questions about blueprint dimensions, load-bearing walls, clearance codes, material estimates, and total square footage with instant citation highlights.
